 Curriculum Vitae





Welcome to my personal website! I’m a researcher interested in addressing complex societal challenges using computational methods like optimization, simulation, and machine learning. I recently completed my PhD at MIT’s Institute for Data, Systems, and Society and I am now a postdoc at the MIT Sloan School of Management. For both, I’ve been advised by Professor Dimitris Bertsimas. Since starting my PhD, my main focus has been the U.S. organ transplant system. Thank you for visiting my website and please feel free to reach out through LinkedIn or email!
